messages:
jamie: FYI in the onboarding sampleapp we just hit confusion around error signals. python SDK throws AuthenticationError on expired token (401) but js SDK surfaces a generic ApiError with 'session invalid' in the body. customers don't know whether to retry or reauth.

sara: oof. we need a small, prescriptive cookbook for mapping HTTP status + body -> typed SDK exceptions and machine-readable hints. minimal proposal: 
- 401 -> AuthenticationError (retryable=false, trigger refresh)
- 403 -> AuthorizationError (retryable=false)
- 404 -> NotFoundError (retryable=false)
- 409 -> ConflictError (retryable=false, include operation_id)
- 429 -> RateLimitError (retryable=true if retry_after)
- 5xx -> TransientServerError (retryable=true)
Also require error body fields: 'retryable', 'retry_after_seconds', 'human_message', 'signal' (enum).

nate: love it. add 'idempotency_hint' for mutating endpoints so SDKs can decide auto-retry. SDKs should expose these as attributes on typed exceptions (e.g., e.retryable, e.retry_after_seconds).

alex: sample machine-readable shape for API and sampleapp: 
```
{
  "error": {
    "type": "rate_limit",
    "message": "per-minute quota exceeded",
    "retryable": true,
    "retry_after_seconds": 12,
    "signal": "quota",
    "operation_hint": "create_index"
  }
}
```
Keep HTTP status codes for transport semantics but use body fields for client behavior.

sara: naming note: prefer 'RateLimitError' not 'TooManyRequestsError'. also suggest 'signal' values: ["quota", "burst", "maintenance"].

jamie: for SDK parity policy: each official SDK must map (status + body.type/signal) -> canonical typed exception and include raw_http_status and raw_body on the exception for debugging.

nate: streaming clients: make sure error frames follow same JSON error shape so the client can treat an error frame like a normal error. add unit tests in sampleapp asserting exception class mapping.

ci-bot: buildkite: sampleapp unit tests passed on ts/go branches :white_check_mark: (coverage +0.7%)

alex: i'll open PRs for ts/go with fixtures, tests, and docs snippet under devex/sample-apps. ETA: EOD Fri.

jamie: i'll author the cookbook markdown and a one-page mapping table (status -> class -> suggested client action). ping @sara @nate @alex for review when PRs land. :rocket:
